rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_primary_business_identifier_unique() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM business_identifier_definitions d WHERE d.id = NEW.definition_id AND d.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND d.primary_flag = TRUE AND d.active_flag = TRUE ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM business_record_identifiers bri WHERE bri.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND bri.definition_id = NEW.definition_id AND bri.normalized_value = NEW.normalized_value AND bri.id <> NEW.id ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Duplicate primary business identifier value for tenant' USING ERRCODE = '23505', CONSTRAINT = 'uq_business_primary_identifier_value'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
